kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتسب (form VIII)
# أَحْتَسِبُ (ʔaḥtasibu) /ʔaħ.ta.si.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# أُحْتَسَبُ (ʔuḥtasabu) /ʔuħ.ta.sa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# أَحْتَسِبَ (ʔaḥtasiba) /ʔaħ.ta.si.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# أُحْتَسَبَ (ʔuḥtasaba) /ʔuħ.ta.sa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
